ache.title: Nerfs make you want the next shiny thing
ache.note: This breaks down the Freezing Rush patch: a controversial Darkrai release, buffs for Ninetales and Machamp, and nerfs for Charizard. Patches like this quietly tell you your favourite got worse and the new one is the answer. That itch is the point of a fresh release.
watch: a new release as the fix
ache.tip: If your main got nerfed, keep playing them a week before switching. Most nerfs feel worse than they are.
lines: new Pokémon, same you. you’re fine

title: Freezing Rush Patch Breakdown! | Pokémon Unite
excerpt: Join me as I dive into the latest Freezing Rush patch notes for Pokémon Unite! We'll discuss the controversial release of Darkrai, buffs for Ninetales and Machamp, nerfs for Charizard, and how Armarouge and other Pokémon are affected. Find out which Pokémon got the best and worst changes in this update. Stay tuned for upcoming gameplay videos!
